title: PSG-23A Rooted Strand and Fiber Foundation
visual_intent: A fresh smooth scalp-and-neck carrier receives a sparse deterministic family of individually rooted, tapered, bent fibers. The proof must read as strands attached to a curved semantic surface, not mound geometry or a material texture.
expected_visual_signal: Hero and grazing views show tapered silhouette-changing fibers. Root, tangent, source-triangle, strand-index, shaft/tip role, and exact-repeat views explain attachment and deterministic construction.
rejection_condition: Reject if the source changes, roots float above the carrier, fibers collapse into mounds, tubes are open, root provenance is missing, strands overlap or self-intersect, or repeated artifacts differ.
